correctness.rationale: On every simple labeled cycle, the chosen 2-label set fixes the remaining Roman labels. A 2-label can be lowered precisely when it has no external private zero-neighbor; with cyclic gaps, that is equivalent to adjacent short gaps. Weighted short and long gaps, closed-walk traces, and -logdet(I-M) give the exact two-variable formal series. The determinant and its derivative give the all-n polynomial, five-term recurrence, and asymptotic via a unique positive dominant pole. Direct enumeration of the original pointwise order and Roman predicate for n=3..12, plus independent gap-subset enumeration for n=3..17, checked every coefficient and returned VERIFY_OK; infinite correctness rests on the proof.

value.rationale: The 2022 literature singled out C5 as an extremal example and derived path counts but left other simple classes for future counting. The new theorem gives every labeled-cycle count simultaneously at each number of defenders and weight, a five-term efficient recurrence, an exact structural gap description, and the leading growth coefficient. This natural all-cardinality classification is not a tiny isolated computation; the pre-existing univariate sequence is expressly excluded from the novelty claim.
